Game Overview

At its heart, Fight with Monster is a action game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Fight with Monster is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Fight with Monster?

Fight with Monster is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Fight with Monster free to play?

Yes, Fight with Monster is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
